title: jacea cineraria
intro: Jacea cineraria, commonly known as Burnet Saxifrage or Mountain Saxifrage, is a flowering plant species within the Saxifragaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Jacea cineraria are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids. Research suggests that the plant may also have antioxidant, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective properties, although further studies are needed to confirm its efficacy.
